io.reader

Class ReadCSV

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.reader.ReadCSV
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Readable, java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String[]>

    public final class ReadCSV
extends java.lang.Object
implements Readable
    Reads CSV files into memory using a quote-aware parser that supports quoted fields, escaped quotes, and multiline records.

    The CSV file is parsed automatically when an instance is constructed. Parsed records are retained in memory until close() is called. The class provides tabular access through Readable and supports row iteration through its iterator implementation.

    A try-with-resources statement is strongly recommended when processing is complete, unless close() is called explicitly.

        public java.util.List<java.lang.String> getColumnValues(java.lang.String headerName)
        Returns the data values for the column identified by its header.

        The first record is treated as the header record. Matching is case-insensitive, and the header itself is excluded from the result.

        Specified by:

        Parameters:

      • sanitise

        private void sanitise(java.lang.String[] rowTokens)
        Sanitises the values in a parsed CSV record.

        Replaces each consecutive sequence of carriage return and line feed characters within a cell value with a single space. Other whitespace, including leading and trailing spaces, is preserved.

        Parameters:
        rowTokens - array of parsed cell values for the current record

      • parseDataCSV

        private java.lang.String[] parseDataCSV(java.io.BufferedReader br)
                                 throws java.io.IOException
        Parses a single CSV record from a BufferedReader, supporting b quoted fields, escaped double quotes, and embedded line breaks.

        Leading whitespace outside quoted fields is skipped, and trailing whitespace is removed from each field. Whitespace handling depends on isWhitespace(char). This parser is permissive and does not enforce all RFC 4180 syntax rules.

        Parameters:
        br - reader positioned at the start of the next CSV record
        Returns:
        parsed field values, or null if EOF is reached before any record is read
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if an unterminated quoted field is encountered at EOF or an I/O error occurs
